description: Extract public comments and reply threads from Facebook posts, photos, reels, videos, and public group posts. Returns comment text, author details, per-reaction-type counts, timestamps, reply context, and the post's own comment totals. No login or cookies required.

commentsMode.description: Which comment view to scrape: MOST_RELEVANT (Facebook's ranked view), NEWEST (all comments, newest first), or ALL (Facebook's unfiltered ranked view, including comments its ranked view may hide).
commentsMode.title: Comment ordering

includeNestedComments.description: If true, also scrape reply rows under top-level comments (with parent/reply metadata). If false, only top-level comments are collected (faster).
includeNestedComments.title: Include replies

maxItems.description: Maximum number of comment rows (including replies) to collect per URL. The run also stops when Facebook has no more comments or replies to serve.
maxItems.title: Max comments per URL

maxReplyDepth.description: How deep into reply threads to collect: 1 = direct replies to top-level comments only, 2 or more = also include deeper nested replies. Facebook serves reply threads with up to two nesting levels to anonymous visitors.
maxReplyDepth.title: Max reply nesting depth

onlyCommentsNewerThan.description: Limit results to comments posted after this date. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, a full ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2024-06-15T12:00:00Z), or a relative value like '1 day', '2 weeks', '3 months', '1 year'. When set, comments are fetched newest-first so the filter can stop as soon as an older comment is reached. Leave blank to disable date filtering.
onlyCommentsNewerThan.title: Only comments newer than

startUrls.description: Facebook post, photo, reel, video, Watch, or public group post URLs (one or more). Comment permalinks (URLs containing ?comment_id=) are accepted and resolved to their post; legacy story.php, permalink.php and share links are normalized automatically. Most public reels and videos are supported; a minority restricted by Facebook return no thread and are reported.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Provide one or more public Facebook URLs to scrape comments from.
startUrls.title: Facebook URLs

title: Facebook Comment Thread Extractor
